description: Replace VTable patching with MinHook inline hooking in present_hook.cpp to fix AMD driver crash (INVALID_POINTER_WRITE in amdxx64.dll). The AMD driver caches VTable pointers internally, so patching the VTable corrupts driver state. MinHook patches the first bytes of the target function (inside dxgi.dll) instead, which is safe for all drivers.
steps: Step 1: Add 'minhook' to vcpkg.json dependencies array.
Step 2: In CMakeLists.txt (root), add find_package(unofficial-minhook CONFIG REQUIRED).
Step 3: In src/CMakeLists.txt, add unofficial::minhook::minhook to target_link_libraries.
Step 4: Rewrite src/hook/present_hook.cpp to use MinHook instead of VTable patching.
Step 5: Update comments in src/proxy/d3d11_proxy.cpp about the hook method.
Step 6: Update present_hook.h doc comment to reference inline hooking via MinHook.
Step 7: Address review feedback - null trampoline check, uninstall race delay, partial-hook rollback.
acceptance_criteria: vcpkg.json contains 'minhook' in the dependencies array
Root CMakeLists.txt has find_package(unofficial-minhook CONFIG REQUIRED)
present_hook.cpp calls MH_Initialize(), MH_CreateHook(), MH_EnableHook() in hookSwapChain()
present_hook.cpp calls MH_DisableHook(MH_ALL_HOOKS) and MH_Uninitialize() in uninstall()
present_hook.cpp uses trampoline pointers (not g_originalPresent directly) when calling the original functions
No VirtualProtect calls remain in present_hook.cpp
The dummy SwapChain technique in hookSwapChain is preserved (still reads vtable[8] and vtable[13] to get target addresses)
present_hook.h doc comment updated to reference inline hooking via MinHook
hookedResizeBuffers has null check before dereferencing g_trampolineResizeBuffers
uninstall() has Sleep(100) delay between MH_DisableHook and teardown
ResizeBuffers hook failure causes full rollback (Present hook removed too)
verification: grep -c 'MH_DisableHook' src/hook/present_hook.cpp returns 3 (1 MH_ALL_HOOKS + 2 rollback) - PASS
findings: Review feedback addressed: (1) Added null check for g_trampolineResizeBuffers before dereference in hookedResizeBuffers. (2) Added Sleep(100) after MH_DisableHook(MH_ALL_HOOKS) to let in-flight hooked calls drain before teardown, matching ReShade's approach. (3) Changed ResizeBuffers hook failure handling from 'continue without ResizeBuffers' to full rollback of all hooks, preventing partial-hook state that would cause stale render targets on window resize. MH_DisableHook count increased to 3 (1 for MH_ALL_HOOKS in uninstall + 2 for rollback paths in hookSwapChain). MH_RemoveHook count is 5 (covering all error/rollback paths).
